verses.text: <pb/><e>Maschil Esaf.</e> <pb/><t>Chineke, n'ìhi gini ka I juworo ayi aju rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi?</t> <t>N'ìhi gini ka iwe Gi nākwu anwuru imegide ìgwè aturu nke ọzùzù-anu-Gi?</t>
<t>Cheta nzukọ-Gi, nke I nwetaworo na mb͕e ochie,</t> <t>Nke I b͕aputaworo ibu ebo nke ihe-nketa-Gi;</t> <t>Cheta ugwu Zaion, ebe I biworo.</t>
<t>Zọlie ije ngwa ngwa ibiaru ebe nile etikpọrọ ebighi-ebi;</t> <t>Onye-iro emewo ihe ọjọ nile n'ebe nsọ.</t>
<t>Ndi nākpab͕u Gi ab͕ọwo uja n'etiti ebe-nzute-Gi;</t> <t>Ha edowo ihe-iriba-ama nile ha ibu ihe-iriba-ama,</t>
<t>Amara ha dika onye nēbuli anyu-ike elu nke-uku</t> <t>N'alùghi-ulù nke osisi.</t>
<t>Ma ub͕u a ihe-ya nile nke eb͕uru eb͕ub͕u,</t> <t>Ha nēwere anyu-ike ntà na otùtù di iche iche tipia ya n'otù.</t>
<t>Ha esuwo ebe nsọ Gi ọku;</t> <t>Ọbuná rue ala ka ha meworo ebe-obibi aha-Gi ka ọ ghara idi nsọ.</t>
<t>Ha siri n'obi-ha, Ka ayi me ha ihe-ike n'otù:</t> <t>Ha esurewo ebe-nzute nile nke Chineke n'ala.</t>
<t>Ayi ahughi ihe-iriba-ama nile ayi:</t> <t>Ọ dighi onye-amuma di ọzọ;</t> <t>Ọ dighi kwa onye nọ n'etiti ayi nke mara mb͕e mb͕e gēru.</t>
<t>Chineke, rùe ole mb͕e ka onye-nkpab͕u gāta uta?</t> <t>Onye-iro, ò gēlelì aha-Gi anya rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi?</t>
<t>N'ìhi gini ka I nēseghachi aka-Gi, bú aka-nri-Gi?</t> <t>Seputa ya n'obi-Gi me ka ha gwusia. <pb/></t>
<t>Ma Chineke bu Ezem site na mb͕e ochie,</t> <t>Nke nālu ọlu nzọputa n'etiti uwa</t>
<t>Gi onwe-gi were ike-Gi tiwa oké osimiri:</t> <t>I tipiara isi nile nke ogologo anu-miri n'elu miri.</t>
<t>Gi onwe-gi tipiasiri isi nile nke oké agu-iyi,</t> <t>I nēnye ya enye iburu otù ndi ihe-oriri, bú ndi bi n'ala kpọrọ nku.</t>
<t>Gi onwe-gi kewara isi-iyi na miri-iyi:</t> <t>Gi onwe-gi mere ka osimiri nile nke nērù erù mb͕e nile takọrọ.</t>
<t>Gi nwe ehihie, ọzọ kwa, Gi nwe abali:</t> <t>Gi onwe-gi edoziwo ihe nēnye ìhè na anyanwu.</t>
<t>Gi onwe-gi emewo ka ókè-ala nile nke uwa guzo ọtọ:</t> <t>Mb͕e okpom-ọku na mb͕e oyi, Gi onwe-gi akpuwo ha.</t>
<t>Cheta nka, na onye-iro atawo Jehova uta,</t> <t>Cheta kwa na otù ndi di nsọkwu eleliwo aha-Gi.</t>
<t>Enyela anu-ọhia nkpuru-obi nke ndi gi:</t> <t>Echezọla ndu nke ndi-Gi ewedara n'ala rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi.</t>
<t>Legide ọb͕ub͕a-ndu-Gi:</t> <t>N'ihi na ebe nile nke b͕ara ọchichiri nke uwa juputara n'ebe-obibi nile nke ihe-ike.</t>
<t>Ekwela ka onye anāzọpia azọpia lata n'ihere:</t> <t>Me ka onye ewedara n'ala na ob͕eye to aha-Gi.</t>
<t>Bilie, Chineke, kpe ọnu-Gi n'ikpe:</t> <t>Cheta uta anāta Gi site n'ọnu onye-nsọkwu ogologo ubọchi nile.</t>
<t>Echezọla olu ndi nākpab͕u Gi:</t> <t>Nkpọtu nke ndi nēbili imegide Gi nāla elu mb͕e nile.</t>
